intake-bot: Duplicate intake detected across support tickets: TKT-234, TKT-287, TKT-301. Possible canonical ask: "Add per-tenant routing tags for request deduping and priority mapping". Auto-suggest 'canonical:TKT-234'.
Sam: saw this cluster this morning, multiple customers hitting same gap via support. want to confirm we should merge under one canonical feature request.
Maya: yes please merge. pattern looks identical — customers ask for tenant-scoped dedupe + priority mapping.
Jorge: quick Q on scope: are we talking metadata-only (tagging + UI filter) or an enforcement path in the runtime? those are very different effort levels.
Sam: support heard two asks: (1) tag + visibility so CS can dedupe at routing time, (2) automatic merge/block at routing layer. most customers start with visibility.
Maya: agree start with metadata + reporting (low lift). label canonical as "intake/merge-visibility" and mark P2. we can surface runtime enforcement in roadmap as follow-up.
Lee: from sales: we need a customer-facing ETA or at least a status note to share with CSMs. can we get a short templated response?
Ashley: I can draft a template and run it by Maya. propose:```Hi {{customer}}, thanks for reporting this. We're tracking this as a canonical request (TKT-234). We're planning an initial visibility rollout (tagging + dashboard) in the next quarter, with a follow-up planned for automatic routing. We'll update you with milestones — please let us know your priority and any blockers.```
Maya: looks good. add fields for customer impact and if they need runtime enforcement sooner.
Jorge: technical note — for visibility we need: DB tag column (backfill plan), UI filter, and an ingestion flag. estimate: 3 dev-sprints + QA. runtime enforcement would be another 3-4 sprints.
Sam: tagging action items for support: (1) merge duplicate tickets into TKT-234 (link them), (2) ping requesters with Ashley's template, (3) add customer impact severity.
Maya: I'll own the canonical ticket. Owner: Maya. Priority: P2. Acceptance criteria: "tags created", "dashboard filter", "customer notifications sent", "backfill plan documented". Roadmap milestone: Q2 delivery window.
Lee: ETA note ok. I'll tell the sales team to use the template and mark interested customers as "candidate for pilot".
Ashley: sending initial messages now (I'll CC support). will post copy of sent messages in the canonical ticket.
intake-bot: System note: merged TKT-287 and TKT-301 into canonical TKT-234 (links added).
Maya: next steps for eng: Jorge to scope a proposal doc + effort estimate by EOD Fri. Jorge?
Jorge: will do. I'll include a minimal schema change, UI mock, and migration plan.
Sam: after Jorge's doc we'll add final priority and decide whether to fast-track for customer pilots.
Maya: thanks all. once Jorge posts the doc I'll update the canonical ticket with launch criteria and the customer notification log. :white_check_mark:
Ashley: posted messages and added a summary in TKT-234. I'll update with any replies. :thumbsup:
Maya: Closing thread here — keeping TKT-234 as the single source of truth. If anyone needs to escalate runtime enforcement to P1, flag it in the ticket with customer signatures.
